records.name: Preset and theme actions
records.purpose: Public functions that define, merge and apply presets, palettes and themes onto the shared Theme configuration.
records.surface: See [authored signatures and interpretation](README.md). definePreset<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(...presets: T[]): T deep-merges presets without applying them. usePreset(...presets) deep-merges then calls Theme.setPreset. updatePreset(...presets) merges the current preset with the arguments and applies it. updatePrimaryPalette(palette?) and updateSurfacePalette(palette?) update the semantic primary or surface palette through $t and return the resulting preset. useTheme<T>(theme: T): T replaces the theme without merging presets. All are re-exported from the package root only.

Setters emit ThemeService events (theme:change, preset:change, options:change, theme:load). Most parameters are typed any.

records.name: Token, CSS and color helpers
records.purpose: Helpers that resolve design tokens, tag CSS templates, build CSS variables from a theme object and derive color scales.
records.surface: See [authored signatures and interpretation](README.md). $dt(tokenPath) returns { name, variable, value }. dt(...args) and dtwt(theme, tokenPath, fallback?, type?) resolve a token to a var() reference or, in strict mode or type "value", to its value. css(strings, ...exprs) is a tag/function that resolves dt() expressions. $t(theme) is a chainable builder with preset, options, primaryPalette, surfacePalette, define, update and use. toVariables(theme, options) returns toVariableOutput (default export, re-exported by name) with the toVariableOptions and toVariableOutput interfaces. mix(color1, color2, weight), shade(color, percent), tint(color, percent) and palette(color) are color utilities; palette returns a ColorScale of shades 50-950 or token references.

records.name: StyleSheet and shared style registrations
records.purpose: A style registry class plus helpers that register theme-variable, hidden-accessible, icon-spin and box-model CSS into a StyleSheet.
records.surface: See [authored signatures and interpretation](README.md). Default export StyleSheet<E = HTMLStyleElement> (re-exported by name) has get, has, delete, clear, add(key, css?), update(key, css), which rewrites a registered entry in place and registers a missing one, getStyles, getAllCSS, getAllMarkup, getAllElements and an overridable createStyleElement that returns undefined by default and an overridable updateStyleElement(element, meta) that does nothing by default; StyleSheetProps and StyleMeta describe its inputs and entries. registerThemeVariables(sheet, componentName) registers common and per-component variable CSS from Theme, and the preset's top-level css as the global style under u-global-style (ticket #172, F4), and registerComponentCss(sheet, componentName, rawCss) registers a component's structural CSS with dt() resolved. Both subscribe the sheet once to theme:change (held weakly) and rewrite their registered CSS in place after Theme.setTheme, setPreset or setOptions. HIDDEN_ACCESSIBLE_KEY, hiddenAccessibleCss and registerHiddenAccessible(sheet), and ICON_SPIN_KEY, iconSpinCss and registerIconSpin(sheet) register idempotent utility CSS. BOX_MODEL_KEY_PREFIX, boxModelCss(roots), scopeRootsOf(classes) and registerBoxModel(sheet, componentName, roots) register scoped border-box rules.

ThemeUtils (default export of themeUtils.ts, re-exported by name) is an object with getCommon, getPreset, getPresetC, deprecated-style getPresetD, applyDarkColorScheme, getColorSchemeOption, getLayerOrder, getCommonStyleSheet, getStyleSheet, createTokens, getTokenValue, getSelectorRule and transformCSS. Parameters are largely typed any.

records.name: Styled package entry and exported types
records.purpose: The package entry barrel, which re-exports every runtime part and declares the public configuration and style types.
records.surface: See [authored signatures and interpretation](README.md). src/index.ts re-exports actions, Theme, color helpers, helper barrel, ThemeService, StyleSheet registrations and utils via named and relative star re-exports. It declares StyleOptions (a dt resolver carrier), StyleType<T = StyleOptions> (a string or function returning CSS), ThemeOptions (prefix, darkModeSelector, cssLayer) and ColorScale (shade keys 0 and 50-950 to hex strings). packages/uix-styled/package.json exports only the root "." subpath, built by tsup from one entry to dist/index.mjs and dist/index.d.mts; there are no subpath exports. The package is a dependency of the Angular, React and Vue core and component packages and of themes.
